comments: Input facts: ego is the car initiator and agent1 the pedestrian responder; agent1 crosses the same trafficway rather than traveling along another road. Chosen assumptions: a straight road with exactly two same-direction lanes, ego in the inner lane and pedestrian crossing from the right sidewalk 19–21 m ahead. After 0.75 s ego changes right at 4.5–5 m/s, putting the vehicle into the pedestrian crossing corridor; agent1 responds within 13–14 m by increasing speed from 1.2–1.4 to 3–3.4 m/s. The lane change is the initiating event. Geometry, timing and the 16 s horizon are assumptions; no collision is prescribed.
